svg.aria-label: Bayesian optimization in one dimension: after 4 trials, a Gaussian process gives a mean estimate of the loss and a band of uncertainty; expected improvement is highest where the estimate is low or the uncertainty large, and the next trial goes there, at 0.61

svg.text: Bayesian optimization: a model of the loss decides the next trial
